scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --dir apps/api exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n tsc,node "pnpm --dir apps/api exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "pnpm --dir apps/api exec node --watch dist/main.js"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/api lint && pnpm --dir apps/web lint
